unitTitle: Be Going To - Will - Present Continuous - It Will Be/There Will Be
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 57-BET. Unit 13 nazariyasining davomi + birinchi mashqlar.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. Nazariya bloklari (Use of will, Present Continuous kelasi zamon uchun, It will be / There will be, Reason-Result-Purpose) to'g'ri ko'chirilgan. 1-mashq (kundalik, 7 kun) va 2-mashq (13 dialog) javoblari TO'G'RI.

⚠ 2-MAShQNING KALITI — 'I KNOW' SO'ZI:
  Agar B 'I KNOW' desa — demak u MUAMMONI BILARDI va rejasi ALLAQAChON bor → BE GOING TO.
     'Your shirt is dirty.' — 'I KNOW. I'M GOING TO wash it later.'
     'We haven't got any tomatoes.' — 'I KNOW. I'M GOING TO buy some.'
  Agar B birinchi marta eshitib, DARHOL qaror qilsa → WILL.
     'It's hot in here.' — 'I'LL open the window.'
     'I can't do this puzzle.' — 'I'LL show you.'
  ⚠ Ya'ni javobni topish uchun B ning birinchi so'ziga qarang.

⚠ YANA IKKI BELGI:
  SAVOL rejani so'rasa → going to: 'What are you doing next weekend?', 'What are Sean's PLANS?'
  SABABNI tushuntirsa → going to: 'Why are you so excited?', 'Why is she wearing these clothes?'
  YORDAM TAKLIF qilsa → will: 'Don't worry, I'LL help you.'

⚠ 'IT WILL BE' va 'THERE WILL BE' FARQI:
  It will be + SIFAT:  'It will be FOGGY tomorrow.'
  There will be + OT:  'There will be FOG tomorrow.'
  ⚠ Ikkalasi bir xil ma'noni beradi, lekin keyingi so'zning turi boshqa.

⚠ 1-MAShQ — KUNDALIK: yetti kunning hammasi Present Continuous bilan yoziladi, chunki bular BELGILANGAN rejalar. Kitob namunani bergan: 'They're going to the cinema on Monday.'
  ⚠ DIQQAT: bu yerda 'going to' KELASI ZAMON QO'ShIMChASI EMAS — 'go' fe'lining davomli shakli ('kinoga BORISHYAPTI'). Chalkashtirmang.

sections.title: Use — Future Simple, Present Continuous
sections.titleUz: Qo'llanishi — Kelasi oddiy zamon, Present Continuous

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI — IKKI VAZIFA:

  We use the FUTURE SIMPLE:

  1) TO MAKE PREDICTIONS BASED ON WHAT WE BELIEVE
     OR IMAGINE
     (biz IShONGAN yoki TASAVVUR QILGAN narsaga
      asoslangan bashorat)

     'There WILL BE rain in Paris tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga Parijda yomg'ir bo'ladi.)

     → Bu shunchaki FIKR yoki tasavvur.
       Ko'rinib turgan DALIL yo'q.

  2) TO MAKE ON-THE-SPOT DECISIONS
     (shu payt qabul qilingan qaror)

     A: 'The phone is ringing.'
        (Telefon jiringlayapti.)
     B: 'I'LL ANSWER it.'
        (Men javob beraman.)

     → Qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul qilindi.
       Oldindan rejalashtirilmagan.


KELASI ZAMON BILAN IShLATILADIGAN VAQT IBORALARI:
     tomorrow                (ertaga)
     soon                    (yaqinda)
     next week/month/etc.    (keyingi hafta/oy)
     the day after tomorrow  (indinga)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'WILL' ↔ 'BE GOING TO':

  BAShORATDA:
     'I think there WILL BE rain tomorrow.'
        → IShONCh, TASAVVUR (dalil yo'q)
     'There are dark clouds. It'S GOING TO rain.'
        → DALIL bor (bulutlar ko'rinib turibdi)

  QARORDA:
     'I'LL answer it.'
        → AYNI DAMDA hal qilindi
     'I'M GOING TO join a gym.'
        → OLDINDAN o'ylangan reja


ESLAB QOLISh:
     Qaror QAChON qabul qilingan?
        HOZIRGINA  →  WILL
        ALLAQAChON →  BE GOING TO

     Bashorat NIMAGA asoslangan?
        FIKRGA / tasavvurga  →  WILL
        KO'RINIB turgan DALILGA  →  BE GOING TO

points.en: We use the future simple to make predictions based on what we believe or imagine.
points.uz: Kelasi oddiy zamonni biz ishongan yoki tasavvur qilgan narsaga asoslangan bashorat uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
Ko'rinib turgan DALIL YO'Q — shunchaki fikr.
Dalil bo'lsa 'be going to' ishlatiladi.

points.en: There will be rain in Paris tomorrow.
points.noteUz:
'rain' — OT → 'THERE will be'.
56-betdagi 'It will be / There will be' qoidasi.

points.en: We use the future simple to make on-the-spot decisions.
points.uz: Kelasi oddiy zamonni shu payt qabul qilingan qaror uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
'on the spot' = ayni damda, joyida.
Oldindan rejalashtirilmagan.

points.en: A: The phone is ringing. B: I'll answer it.
points.uz: A: Telefon jiringlayapti. B: Men javob beraman.
points.noteUz:
Telefon jiringlagani uchun AYNI DAMDA
qaror qildi.
'I will' → 'I'LL'.

points.en: Time expressions: tomorrow, soon, next week/month/etc., the day after tomorrow, etc.
points.uz: Vaqt iboralari: ertaga, yaqinda, keyingi hafta/oy, indinga va h.k.
points.noteUz:
Bu iboralar KELASI zamonni ko'rsatadi.
'next week' — 'the' YO'Q.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — IKKI VAZIFA:


1) QAT'IY BELGILANGAN KELAJAK IShLARI
   'We can use the present continuous to talk
    about FIXED FUTURE ARRANGEMENTS.'

   'I AM SEEING John tonight.'
   (Bugun kechqurun Jon bilan uchrashaman.)

   → Kelishilgan, vaqti belgilangan.


   HARAKAT FE'LLARI BILAN AYNIQSA KO'P:
   'With verbs of movement such as: COME, GO,
    FLY, TRAVEL, LEAVE etc.'

   'I AM FLYING to Athens TOMORROW.
    My plane IS LEAVING at 6 am.'
   (Ertaga Afinaga uchaman. Samolyotim ertalab
    soat 6 da jo'naydi.)

   → Chipta olingan, reys vaqti aniq.


2) HOZIR SODIR BO'LAYOTGAN HARAKAT
   'We also use the present continuous for
    ACTIONS HAPPENING NOW, at the moment of
    speaking.'

   'IT'S SNOWING at the moment.'
   (Hozir qor yog'yapti.)

   → Gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'lmoqda.


HARAKAT FE'LLARI (verbs of movement) — RO'YXAT:
     come    (kelmoq)
     go      (bormoq)
     fly     (uchmoq)
     travel  (sayohat qilmoq)
     leave   (jo'nab ketmoq)
     arrive  (yetib kelmoq)
     start   (boshlamoq)
     return  (qaytmoq)

  Bu fe'llar kelajak rejasi haqida gapirganda
  deyarli DOIM present continuous da keladi.


ENG MUHIM — UCh XIL KELAJAKNI AJRATISh:

  BE GOING TO   →  REJA/NIYAT, aniq vaqt YO'Q
     'I'm going to visit John.'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS →  BELGILANGAN, aniq vaqt BOR
     'I'm seeing John tonight.'

  WILL          →  TAXMIN yoki AYNI DAMDAGI qaror
     'I think I'll see John.'


DIQQAT — 'I AM SEEING':
  'see' odatda HOLAT fe'li ('-ing' olmaydi):
     'I SEE a bird.' (ko'raman)
  LEKIN 'uchrashmoq' ma'nosida HARAKAT fe'li:
     'I AM SEEING John tonight.' (uchrashaman)
  Ikki xil ma'no — ikki xil qoida.


Coursebook 93 va 94-betlardagi qoidalar
shu yerda BIRLAShTIRILGAN.

points.en: We can use the present continuous to talk about fixed future arrangements.
points.uz: 'present continuous' ni qat'iy belgilangan kelajak ishlari haqida gapirish uchun ishlatishimiz mumkin.
points.noteUz:
Kelishilgan, vaqti belgilangan ish.
Coursebook 93-betdagi qoida.

DIQQAT: 'see' odatda HOLAT fe'li ('I see a
bird'), lekin 'UCHRASHMOQ' ma'nosida
HARAKAT fe'li → '-ing' oladi.

points.en: With verbs of movement such as: come, go, fly, travel, leave etc.
points.uz: Harakat fe'llari bilan: come, go, fly, travel, leave va h.k.
points.noteUz:
Bu fe'llar kelajak rejasi haqida gapirganda
deyarli DOIM present continuous da keladi.

points.en: I am flying to Athens tomorrow. My plane is leaving at 6 am.
points.uz: Ertaga Afinaga uchaman. Samolyotim ertalab soat 6 da jo'naydi.
points.noteUz:
Chipta olingan, reys vaqti aniq.
'TOMORROW' va 'AT 6 AM' — aniq vaqt.

points.en: We also use the present continuous for actions happening now, at the moment of speaking.
points.uz: 'present continuous' ni hozir, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan harakat uchun ham ishlatamiz.

points.noteUz:
'at the moment' = hozir.
Gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'lmoqda.

exercises.instructionEn: It will be / There will be
exercises.instructionUz: It will be / There will be
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  'IT WILL BE + ADJECTIVE (SIFAT)'
     'IT WILL BE FOGGY tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga tumanli bo'ladi.)

  'THERE WILL BE + NOUN (OT)'
     'THERE WILL BE FOG tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga tuman bo'ladi.)


QOIDA:
  Bo'shliqdan keyin SIFAT bormi yoki OT?
     SIFAT  →  IT will be
     OT     →  THERE will be


OB-HAVO JUFTLIKLARI:

     SIFAT          OT
     ─────────────  ─────────────
     foggy          fog
     rainy          rain
     sunny          sunshine
     snowy          snow
     windy          strong winds
     cloudy         clouds
     stormy         a storm

  Har juftlik uchun IKKI xil gap:
     'IT will be FOGGY tomorrow.'
     'THERE will be FOG tomorrow.'
     Ma'no BIR XIL.


ENG SODDA IP:
  Ob-havo so'zi '-y' bilan tugasa — SIFAT → IT.
  '-y' siz bo'lsa — OT → THERE.


YUQORIDAGI 'USE' QUTISIDA HAM ShU QOIDA:
  'THERE will be RAIN in Paris tomorrow.'
     ('rain' — OT → THERE)


Coursebook 95-betdagi quti bilan AYNAN bir xil.
exercises.bookRef: Grammar Book, 57-bet, It will be / There will be

points.en: It will be + adjective: It will be foggy tomorrow.
points.uz: It will be + SIFAT: Ertaga tumanli bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
SIFAT → 'IT will be'.
foggy, rainy, sunny, snowy, windy — sifatlar
('-y' bilan tugaydi).

points.en: There will be + noun: There will be fog tomorrow.
points.uz: There will be + OT: Ertaga tuman bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
OT → 'THERE will be'.
fog, rain, sunshine, snow, strong winds — otlar.

points.en: foggy ↔ fog; rainy ↔ rain; sunny ↔ sunshine; snowy ↔ snow; windy ↔ strong winds
points.uz: foggy ↔ fog; rainy ↔ rain; sunny ↔ sunshine; snowy ↔ snow; windy ↔ strong winds
points.noteUz:
Har juftlik uchun IKKI xil gap tuzish mumkin.
Ma'no BIR XIL.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  • SABABNI 'BECAUSE' bilan, NATIJANI 'SO' bilan
    ifodalaymiz.
  • SABAB yoki MAQSADNI 'TO + INFINITIVE' bilan
    ham ifodalaymiz (maqsad infinitivi).


UCh NAMUNA — BIR XIL FIKR, UCh XIL SHAKL:

  1) REASON (SABAB) — 'because'
     'She's going to save money BECAUSE she wants
      to go on holiday.'
     (U pul yig'moqchi, ChUNKI ta'tilga bormoqchi.)

  2) RESULT (NATIJA) — 'so'
     'She wants to go on holiday, SO she's going
      to save money.'
     (U ta'tilga bormoqchi, ShUNING UChUN pul
      yig'moqchi.)

  3) PURPOSE (MAQSAD) — 'to + fe'l'
     'She's going to save money TO GO on holiday.'
     (U ta'tilga borish UChUN pul yig'moqchi.)


ENG MUHIM — GAP TARTIBI TESKARI:

  BECAUSE:
     [NATIJA] because [SABAB]
     'save money'  ←  'wants to go on holiday'

  SO:
     [SABAB], so [NATIJA]
     'wants to go on holiday'  →  'save money'

  Ya'ni bir xil ikki fikr, lekin O'RINLARI
  ALMAShADI.


'TO + fe'l' (maqsad infinitivi):
  Eng QISQA shakl.
  Ergash gapda EGA YO'Q:
     'to go on holiday'      ✓
     'to she goes on holiday' ✗


QANDAY TANLASh:
  Ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bormi?
     HA   →  'because' yoki 'so'
     YO'Q →  'to + fe'l'


Coursebook 95-betdagi quti bilan AYNAN bir xil.
Coursebook 93-betdagi Speaking mashqi ham
shu qoidaga asoslangan edi.
exercises.bookRef: Grammar Book, 57-bet, Expressing Reason, Result or Purpose

points.en: We express reason with because and result with so.
points.noteUz:
DIQQAT: gap tartibi TESKARI.
because dan keyin — SABAB.
so dan keyin — NATIJA.

points.en: We also express reason or purpose with to + infinitive (infinitive of purpose).
points.uz: Sabab yoki maqsadni 'to + fe'l' bilan ham ifodalaymiz (maqsad infinitivi).
points.noteUz:
Eng QISQA shakl.
Ergash gapda EGA YO'Q.

points.en: She's going to save money because she wants to go on holiday. (reason)
points.uz: U pul yig'moqchi, chunki ta'tilga bormoqchi. (SABAB)
points.noteUz:
'because' dan keyin EGA va FE'L bor
('she wants').

points.en: She wants to go on holiday, so she's going to save money. (result)
points.uz: U ta'tilga bormoqchi, shuning uchun pul yig'moqchi. (NATIJA)
points.noteUz:
Tartib 'because' ga nisbatan TESKARI.
'so' dan OLDIN VERGUL.

points.en: She's going to save money to go on holiday. (purpose)
points.uz: U ta'tilga borish uchun pul yig'moqchi. (MAQSAD)
points.noteUz:
Eng QISQA shakl.
'to' dan keyin faqat FE'L (ega yo'q).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at Tom and Heather's diary below. Then, use the present continuous form to say what their arrangements are for this week, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi Tom va Xezerning kundaligiga qarang. So'ng ularning shu haftadagi belgilangan ishlarini present continuous shaklida ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
TOM VA XEZERNING KUNDALIGI:

     Monday    -  go to the cinema
     Tuesday   -  visit Heather's parents
     Wednesday -  take the car to a mechanic
     Thursday  -  buy a computer
     Friday    -  clean the house
     Saturday  -  have a dinner party
     Sunday    -  go on a picnic


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'They'RE GOING to the cinema ON MONDAY.'


NEGA PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  Bu ishlar KUNDALIKKA yozilgan —
  ya'ni QAT'IY BELGILANGAN (fixed arrangements).
  Har birining ANIQ KUNI bor.

  57-betdagi qoida: belgilangan kelajak ishi →
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS.


QOLIP:
  They'RE + fe'l-ING + ... + ON + [kun].

  DIQQAT: KUN bilan 'ON' predlogi.


BARCHA YETTI GAP:

  1  They're going to the cinema on Monday.
                                        (NAMUNA)
  2  They're visiting Heather's parents on
     Tuesday.
  3  They're taking the car to a mechanic on
     Wednesday.
  4  They're buying a computer on Thursday.
  5  They're cleaning the house on Friday.
  6  They're having a dinner party on Saturday.
  7  They're going on a picnic on Sunday.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Dushanba kuni kinoga borishadi.
  2  Seshanba kuni Xezerning ota-onasinikiga
     borishadi.
  3  Chorshanba kuni mashinani ustaga olib
     borishadi.
  4  Payshanba kuni kompyuter sotib olishadi.
  5  Juma kuni uyni yig'ishtirishadi.
  6  Shanba kuni kechki ziyofat qilishadi.
  7  Yakshanba kuni piknikka borishadi.


FE'LLARNING '-ING' ShAKLI:
     go     → GOING
     visit  → VISITING
     take   → TAKING     ('-e' TUShADI)
     buy    → BUYING
     clean  → CLEANING
     have   → HAVING     ('-e' TUShADI)

  DIQQAT: '-e' bilan tugagan fe'llarda 'e'
  TUShADI: take → taking, have → having.


DIQQAT — IKKI XIL 'GO':
  1-gap: 'going TO the cinema'
     → 'go TO + JOY'
  7-gap: 'going ON a picnic'
     → 'go ON a picnic' (turg'un ibora)

  Shunday: go ON holiday, go ON a trip,
  go ON a journey, go ON a picnic.


DIQQAT — 'HAVE A DINNER PARTY':
  'have a party' = ziyofat qilmoq.
  'make a party' XATO.
  Bu yerda 'have' — HARAKAT fe'li → '-ing' oladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a diary    = kundalik
  a mechanic = usta, mexanik
  a dinner party = kechki ziyofat
  a picnic   = piknik

modelSentences.sentence: They're going to the cinema on Monday.
modelSentences.uz: Dushanba kuni kinoga borishadi. (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — 'go TO + JOY')

modelSentences.sentence: They're visiting Heather's parents on Tuesday.
modelSentences.uz: Seshanba kuni Xezerning ota-onasinikiga borishadi. ('visit' — predlogSIZ)

modelSentences.word: Wednesday — take the car to a mechanic
modelSentences.sentence: They're taking the car to a mechanic on Wednesday.
modelSentences.uz: Chorshanba kuni mashinani ustaga olib borishadi. (take → TAKING, '-e' tushadi)

modelSentences.sentence: They're buying a computer on Thursday.
They're cleaning the house on Friday.
They're having a dinner party on Saturday.
modelSentences.uz: Shanba kuni kechki ziyofat qilishadi. (have → HAVING; 'make a party' XATO)

modelSentences.sentence: They're going on a picnic on Sunday.
modelSentences.uz: Yakshanba kuni piknikka borishadi. ('go ON a picnic' — turg'un ibora)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in with will or the correct form of be going to.
exercises.instructionUz: 'will' yoki 'be going to' ning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N UCh DIALOG — HAR BIRIDA BITTA BO'ShLIQ.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  I'LL drive you there.
   2  I'M GOING TO wash it later.
   3  I'M GOING TO buy some this afternoon.
   4  I'LL help you.
   5  I'M GOING TO buy some new clothes next week.
   6  I'LL open the window.
   7  I'LL show you how to do it.
   8  I'LL take you to the doctor.
   9  I'M GOING TO visit my parents.
  10  I'LL call a mechanic.
  11  She'S GOING TO have dinner with Paul.
  12  He'S GOING TO work at a restaurant.
  13  I'M GOING TO play basketball with Peter.

  WILL — YETTITA:        1, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10
         (olti dona)
  BE GOING TO — YETTITA: 2, 3, 5, 9, 11, 12, 13


ENG MUHIM QOIDA — QANDAY AJRATISh:

  WILL  →  javob beruvchi AYNI DAMDA qaror qildi
           (oldin bilmagan)

  BE GOING TO  →  javob beruvchi ALLAQAChON
                  rejalashtirgan (oldin bilgan)


IKKI ANIQ IP:

  IP 1 — 'I KNOW' BORMI?
     Agar javob 'I know' bilan boshlansa,
     demak u ALLAQAChON bilgan va rejalashtirgan
     → BE GOING TO.
     (2 va 3-bandlar)

  IP 2 — SAVOL REJA HAQIDAMI?
     'What are you doing next weekend?'
     'What are Sean's plans for the summer?'
     → REJA so'ralmoqda → BE GOING TO.
     (9 va 12-bandlar)

  Qolgan hollarda:
     A biror MUAMMO aytadi →
     B AYNI DAMDA yordam taklif qiladi → WILL.


HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

   1  A: 'I need to go to the dentist.'
      B: 'Okay, I'LL drive you there.'
      → 'Okay' — ayni damdagi reaksiya. WILL.

   2  A: 'Your shirt is dirty.'
      B: 'I KNOW. I'M GOING TO wash it later.'
      → 'I know' — allaqachon bilgan va
        rejalashtirgan. BE GOING TO.

   3  A: 'We haven't got any tomatoes.'
      B: 'I KNOW. I'M GOING TO buy some this
          afternoon.'
      → 'I know' — allaqachon rejalashtirgan.
        BE GOING TO.

   4  A: 'I don't understand this exercise!'
      B: 'Don't worry, I'LL help you.'
      → 'Don't worry' — ayni damdagi yordam
        taklifi. WILL.

   5  A: 'Why are you so excited?'
      B: 'I'M GOING TO buy some new clothes next
          week.'
      → Hayajonining SABABI — allaqachon
        rejalashtirgan. BE GOING TO.

   6  A: 'It's hot in here.'
      B: 'I'LL open the window.'
      → Ayni damdagi qaror. WILL.

   7  A: 'I can't do this puzzle.'
      B: 'I'LL show you how to do it.'
      → Ayni damdagi yordam taklifi. WILL.

   8  A: 'I'm not feeling well.'
      B: 'I'LL take you to the doctor.'
      → Ayni damdagi qaror. WILL.

   9  A: 'What are you doing next weekend?'
      B: 'I'M GOING TO visit my parents.'
      → REJA so'ralmoqda. BE GOING TO.

  10  A: 'There's something wrong with the car.'
      B: 'I'LL call a mechanic.'
      → Ayni damdagi qaror. WILL.

  11  A: 'Why is she wearing these clothes?'
      B: 'She'S GOING TO have dinner with Paul.'
      → Kiyimining SABABI — allaqachon
        rejalashtirgan. BE GOING TO.

  12  A: 'What are Sean's plans for the summer?'
      B: 'He'S GOING TO work at a restaurant to
          earn some money.'
      → 'PLANS' so'zi bevosita aytilgan.
        BE GOING TO.

  13  A: 'What are you looking for?'
      B: 'My basketball. I'M GOING TO play
          basketball with Peter.'
      → To'pni qidirayotganining SABABI —
        allaqachon rejalashtirgan. BE GOING TO.


NAQSh — UCh TUR:

  A) MUAMMO → YORDAM TAKLIFI  (WILL)
     1, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10-bandlar
     A biror qiyinchilikni aytadi,
     B darhol yordam beradi.

  B) 'I KNOW' → REJA  (BE GOING TO)
     2, 3-bandlar

  C) SABAB TUShUNTIRISh → REJA  (BE GOING TO)
     5, 9, 11, 12, 13-bandlar
     'Why ...?' yoki 'What are ... plans?'
     savoliga javob.


DIQQAT — 5, 11, 13-BANDLAR NEGA 'GOING TO':
  Bu uch bandda javob HOZIRGI HOLATNI
  TUShUNTIRADI:
     nega hayajonlangan? — chunki reja bor
     nega bunday kiyingan? — chunki reja bor
     nega to'pni qidiryapti? — chunki reja bor
  Reja ALLAQAChON mavjud → BE GOING TO.


EGAGA E'TIBOR BERING:
  11-band: 'SHE'S going to ...' (she → is)
  12-band: 'HE'S going to ...'  (he → is)
  Qolganlari: 'I'M going to ...' (I → am)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a mechanic = usta, mexanik
  a puzzle   = boshqotirma
  excited    = hayajonlangan
  to look for = qidirmoq
  something wrong = biror nosozlik

items.textEn: 1  A: I need to go to the dentist.  B: Okay, I ............ drive you there.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.
'Okay' so'zi buni ko'rsatadi: B endigina eshitdi
va darhol yordam taklif qildi.
Oldindan rejalashtirilmagan.

items.textEn: 2  A: Your shirt is dirty.  B: I know. I ............ wash it later.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — ALLAQACHON rejalashtirgan.
'I KNOW' — B buni oldin ham bilgan va yuvishni
rejalashtirgan.
Agar 'will' bo'lsa — endigina qaror qilgan
bo'lardi, lekin 'I know' bunga zid.

items.textEn: 3  A: We haven't got any tomatoes.  B: I know. I ............ buy some this afternoon.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — ALLAQACHON rejalashtirgan.
'I KNOW' — 2-band bilan bir xil ip.
B pomidor yo'qligini bilgan va sotib olishni
rejalashtirgan.

items.textEn: 4  A: I don't understand this exercise!  B: Don't worry, I ............ help you.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA yordam taklifi.
'Don't worry' so'zi buni ko'rsatadi.
B muammoni endigina eshitdi.

items.textEn: 5  A: Why are you so excited?  B: I ............ buy some new clothes next week.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — ALLAQACHON rejalashtirgan.
B nega hayajonlanganini TUSHUNTIRADI:
chunki reja bor.
Reja oldindan mavjud bo'lgani uchun u
hayajonlangan.

items.textEn: 6  A: It's hot in here.  B: I ............ open the window.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.
Issiqligini eshitib, darhol derazani ochishga
qaror qildi.
Coursebook 95-betdagi 11-mashqda ham shu misol.

items.textEn: 7  A: I can't do this puzzle.  B: I ............ show you how to do it.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA yordam taklifi.
'a puzzle' = boshqotirma.
'show sb HOW TO do sth' — qolip.

items.textEn: 8  A: I'm not feeling well.  B: I ............ take you to the doctor.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.
'I'm not feeling well' = o'zimni yaxshi his
qilmayapman.
'take sb TO the doctor' — predlog TO.

items.textEn: 9  A: What are you doing next weekend?  B: I ............ visit my parents.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — REJA so'ralmoqda.
'What are you doing next weekend?' —
kelajak REJASI haqidagi savol.
Javob ham reja bo'lishi kerak.

items.textEn: 10  A: There's something wrong with the car.  B: I ............ call a mechanic.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.
Nosozlikni eshitib, darhol ustani chaqirishga
qaror qildi.
'something wrong with' = ... da nosozlik.

items.textEn: 11  A: Why is she wearing these clothes?  B: She ............ have dinner with Paul.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — ALLAQACHON rejalashtirgan.
B uning nega bunday kiyinganini TUSHUNTIRADI:
chunki reja bor.
DIQQAT — EGA: 'SHE' → 'SHE'S going to'
('she is'), 'I'm' EMAS.

items.textEn: 12  A: What are Sean's plans for the summer?  B: He ............ work at a restaurant to earn some money.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — savolda 'PLANS' so'zi BEVOSITA
aytilgan.
DIQQAT — EGA: 'HE' → 'HE'S going to'.
'TO EARN' — maqsad infinitivi
(yuqoridagi 'Expressing Purpose' qoidasi).

items.textEn: 13  A: What are you looking for?  B: My basketball. I ............ play basketball with Peter.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — ALLAQACHON rejalashtirgan.
B nega to'pni qidirayotganini TUSHUNTIRADI:
chunki Piter bilan o'ynash rejasi bor.
'look FOR' = qidirmoq (predlog FOR).

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar 57-bet — uch xil kelajak va sabab/natija/maqsad.

items.derivedUz: I'm going to wash it later.

groups.explanationUz: Kelajak rejasida deyarli doim present continuous.

items.derived: I'm going to the cinema on Monday.
My plane is leaving at 6 am.

items.derivedUz: ... because she wants to go on holiday
She wants to go on holiday, so ...

items.derived: take the car to a mechanic

patterns.exampleEn: They're going to the cinema on Monday. They're having a dinner party on Saturday.
patterns.exampleUz: Dushanba kuni kinoga borishadi. Shanba kuni kechki ziyofat qilishadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Kundalikka yozilgan, ANIQ KUNI bor ish →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
KUN bilan 'ON' predlogi.

patterns.exampleEn: It's hot in here. — I'll open the window. The phone is ringing. — I'll answer it.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu yerda issiq. — Derazani ochaman. Telefon jiringlayapti. — Javob beraman.
patterns.explanationUz:
A muammoni aytadi, B AYNI DAMDA yordam
taklif qiladi → WILL.

patterns.formula: I KNOW. I'M GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.   (allaqachon reja)
patterns.exampleEn: Your shirt is dirty. — I know. I'm going to wash it later.
patterns.explanationUz:
'I know' — allaqachon bilgan va rejalashtirgan
→ BE GOING TO ('will' XATO bo'lardi).

patterns.formula: IT WILL BE + SIFAT.   /   THERE WILL BE + OT.
patterns.exampleEn: It will be foggy tomorrow. There will be fog tomorrow.
patterns.exampleUz: Ertaga tumanli bo'ladi. Ertaga tuman bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
SIFAT → IT, OT → THERE.
Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat shakl boshqa.

patterns.formula: A BECAUSE B.  /  B, SO A.  /  A TO + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: She's going to save money because she wants to go on holiday. / She wants to go on holiday, so she's going to save money. / She's going to save money to go on holiday.
patterns.exampleUz: U pul yig'moqchi, chunki ta'tilga bormoqchi. / U ta'tilga bormoqchi, shuning uchun pul yig'moqchi. / U ta'tilga borish uchun pul yig'moqchi.
patterns.explanationUz:
SABAB / NATIJA / MAQSAD.
'because' va 'so' da tartib TESKARI.
'to + fe'l' — eng qisqa shakl.
